primary_claim: The authors release a suite of batch topk Matryoshka SAEs (standard and snap-loss variants) trained on all residual stream layers of Gemma-2-2b, Gemma-2-9b, and Gemma-3-1b, publicly via SAELens and Neuronpedia, and find no meaningful practical difference between snap-loss and standard SAEs trained on these LLMs.

effect.metric: explained variance, snap-loss vs. standard Matryoshka SAE (per layer)
effect.value: no meaningful practical difference observed between snap-loss and standard SAEs trained on Gemma-2-2b

stated_future_work: investigate whether it's possible to intentionally balance hedging with absorption in a more optimal way
limitations_stated: hyperparameters were not aggressively optimized, so more training tokens or better learning-rate choices could likely improve performance
quote: we trained batch topk Matryoshka SAEs on all residual stream layers of Gemma-2-2b, Gemma-2-9b, and Gemma-3-1b, and are now releasing them publicly.
